title: Agency men say they follow the Varginha investigation

tellings.quote: and they're, "Oh, yeah. No, we know exactly what you've been doing."

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker, says that at an event, men from a government agency told him they knew exactly what he had been doing in his investigation of the Varginha case, a story from a town in Brazil where an alien is said to have been captured, and he mentions a person named Leslie in connection with it. If true, it would mean officials are quietly keeping an eye on his work.
